general.languageDesc: Select the display language for the M.A.R.A.S dashboard, modals, notifications, and in-game text.
general.reloadLocalizationDesc: Re-read localization JSON files from Data/SKSE/Plugins/MARAS/localization/ without restarting Skyrim.
general.autoPauseDesc: Automatically pause Skyrim whenever the M.A.R.A.S dashboard is opened. You can also pause or unpause at any time using the Pause button in the top-right header bar.
general.fullScreenDesc: Open the M.A.R.A.S dashboard in full-screen mode instead of a centered window.
general.uiScaleDesc: Scale all fonts, icons, cards, and UI elements proportionally across the dashboard and modals ({percent}%).
general.skipWeddingDesc: Immediately complete marriages without scheduling a ceremony at the Temple of Mara.
general.affectionDecayDesc: Scale daily affection decay rate when not interacting ({mult}x).
general.lonelinessThresholdDesc: Master time unit (L = {days}d): days without meaningful interaction before daily affection decay begins, and base unit scaling all Player Partner Agency intervals (scan every {scanDays}d, talking-to-physical affair escalation after {escalationDays}d).
general.enablePolygamyDesc: Allow marrying multiple spouses and establishing rank hierarchies.
general.disablePolygamyQuestDesc: Prevent 'The Flame Divides Not' quest from starting. If currently running, stops and resets the quest.
general.hotkeyModifiersDesc: Require Ctrl / Shift / Alt keys in combination with your configured toggle key.

confirmations.bannerDesc: Confirmation dialogs require confirmation before major relationship changes take effect.
confirmations.bannerSkyrimNet: SkyrimNet is detected: Modals will include a third "Decline (Explain)" button allowing freeform dialogue responses.
confirmations.enableMasterDesc: Master toggle for all in-game confirmation popups. If disabled, all relationship transitions are auto-accepted without prompts.
confirmations.playerNpcDesc: Show confirmation modals when the player character is directly involved.
confirmations.npcNpcDesc: Show confirmation modals when interactions occur between two NPCs without player involvement.
confirmations.confirmDatingDesc: Require confirmation modal when proposing or entering a dating relationship.
confirmations.confirmEngagementDesc: Require confirmation modal when proposing or accepting an engagement.
confirmations.confirmLoverDesc: Require confirmation modal when proposing or becoming lovers.
confirmations.confirmMarryDesc: Require confirmation modal when proposing or accepting a marriage proposal.
confirmations.breakupDatingDesc: Require confirmation modal when breaking up a dating relationship.
confirmations.breakupEngagementDesc: Require confirmation modal when breaking off an engagement.
confirmations.breakupLoverDesc: Require confirmation modal when ending a lover relationship.
confirmations.divorceDesc: Require confirmation modal when an NPC or partner requests divorce.
confirmations.lowAffectionDivorceDesc: Require confirmation modal during low affection divorce questline.
confirmations.openRelDesc: Require confirmation modal when opening an existing relationship.
confirmations.closeRelDesc: Require confirmation modal when closing an open relationship.

matchmaking.scheduledAiSubtitle: Evaluates romantic prospects in the background using SkyrimNet LLM
matchmaking.scheduledAutoSubtitle: Evaluates romantic prospects in the background using algorithmic Dice Roll chances
matchmaking.autoScheduledAiDesc: Periodically evaluate the world NPC roster in the background using SkyrimNet LLM.
matchmaking.autoScheduledDiceDesc: Periodically evaluate the world NPC roster in the background using algorithmic Dice Roll probability.
matchmaking.useAiDesc: When enabled, scheduled matchmaking uses SkyrimNet AI to evaluate pairings. When disabled, the algorithmic Dice Roll system is used instead (with AI verification and memory generation).
matchmaking.evaluationStepDesc: When enabled, candidate pairs from scheduled matchmaking undergo a secondary LLM narrative evaluation before being applied.
matchmaking.llmMemoriesDesc: When enabled, matchmaking uses SkyrimNet's memory LLM to generate narrative first-person memories. When disabled, matchmaking memories are built programmatically without sending an LLM request.
matchmaking.confirmResultsDesc: When enabled, presents an interactive checklist modal to review, adjust, or reject proposed NPC pairings before they are applied in-game.
matchmaking.intervalDaysDesc_one: Number of in-game days between automated matchmaking evaluations ({count} day).
matchmaking.intervalDaysDesc_other: Number of in-game days between automated matchmaking evaluations ({count} days).
matchmaking.maxSuggestionsDesc_one: Maximum number of NPC pair changes proposed per automated run ({count} suggestion).
matchmaking.maxSuggestionsDesc_other: Maximum number of NPC pair changes proposed per automated run ({count} suggestions).
matchmaking.npcCooldownDesc_one: Number of in-game days an NPC must wait after a scheduled relationship change before they can be changed again ({count} day).
matchmaking.npcCooldownDesc_other: Number of in-game days an NPC must wait after a scheduled relationship change before they can be changed again ({count} days).
matchmaking.diceChancesIntro: Configure the relative probability weights for each matchmaking action. Sliders auto-normalize to ensure the total is always 100%.
matchmaking.chanceNewDatingDesc: Probability of initiating a new Dating relationship between two eligible single NPCs.
matchmaking.chanceNewEngagedDesc: Probability of initiating a direct Engagement between two eligible single NPCs.
matchmaking.chanceNewLoverAllowedDesc: Probability of establishing a secondary Lover relationship where partners allow it (single or open main pair).
matchmaking.chanceNewLoverCheatingDesc: Probability of establishing a secondary Lover relationship that constitutes infidelity (closed main pair).
matchmaking.chanceNewLoverCheatingDisabledDesc: Disabled because Allow Cheating / Infidelity is turned off below.
matchmaking.chanceAdvanceDesc: Probability of progressing an existing relationship (Dating to Engaged, Engaged to Married, Lover to Dating).
matchmaking.chanceBreakupDesc: Probability of dissolving an existing relationship (Dating to Ex-Dating, Married to Divorced, etc.).
matchmaking.chanceBreakupDisabledDesc: Disabled because Allow AI Breakups is turned off below.
matchmaking.chanceOpenCloseDesc: Probability of modifying relationship exclusivity (opening an exclusive pair or closing an open pair).
matchmaking.chanceOpenCloseDisabledDesc: Disabled because Allow Open / Close Modifications is turned off below.
matchmaking.orientationDesc: Constrain partner suggestions to specific gender combinations across automated and manual evaluation.
matchmaking.allowCheatingDesc: Permit proposing secondary lover relationships for NPCs who are already in exclusive/closed main partnerships.
matchmaking.allowBreakupsDesc: Permit proposing breakups, divorces, and separations for existing relationships when appropriate.
matchmaking.allowOpenCloseDesc: Permit proposing opening exclusive relationships or making open relationships exclusive.
matchmaking.manualActionsSubtitle: Trigger immediate AI evaluations across all Skyrim NPCs without waiting for interval timers
matchmaking.manualWorldScanDesc: Evaluate romantic prospects across all Skyrim NPCs immediately and open the AI dashboard to review and apply matches.

partnerAgency.engineSubtitle: Dedicated Tier 2 agency (2-stage affairs, open-relationship lovers, breakups, force-greet intents & home-arrival events) for all active player main partners
partnerAgency.enableCheatingDesc: Independently evaluate the player's closed-relationship partners (Dating, Engaged, Married) for secret infidelity (2-stage Talking/Physical affairs, affair breakups, confessions, and home-arrival cheating scenarios), regardless of whether generic NPC matchmaking is enabled.
partnerAgency.enableOpenRelDesc: Independently evaluate the player's partners for open-relationship agency (seeking consensual side lovers, open-lover breakups, proposing to open or close the relationship, and home-arrival open-relationship scenarios), regardless of whether generic NPC matchmaking is enabled.
partnerAgency.useAiStage2Desc: When a partner passes a Stage 1 probability check, ask SkyrimNet AI to evaluate whether they act on it and pick the most fitting local candidate. When disabled, weighted dice rolls select from the shortlisted candidates.
partnerAgency.confirmResultsLabel: Review Partner Agency Results in Modal
partnerAgency.confirmResultsDesc: Present an interactive confirmation modal before applying any new side-lover relationship or breakup initiated by a player partner.
partnerAgency.enableForceGreetsDesc: Allow player partners to queue relationship conversations (suggesting an open or closed relationship, or confessing guilt after ending an affair; expires after {days} [{mult}x L] if ignored).
partnerAgency.enableHomeArrivalDesc: Evaluate active side-lover scenarios and handwritten note modals (open-lover inn dates, suspicious talking-stage letters, or in-house encounters) when arriving at a partner's home.
partnerAgency.temptationSubtitle: Configure probability multipliers, roll caps, and loyalty anchors for player partners
partnerAgency.temptationMultDesc: Scales calculated Stage 1 cheating temptation probabilities across all closed player partners ({mult}x).
partnerAgency.openDesireMultDesc: Scales Stage 1 desire for open-relationship player partners to pursue consensual side lovers ({mult}x).
partnerAgency.breakupMultDesc: Scales probability of player partners ending existing secret affairs or open-relationship side flings after {days} ({mult}x).
partnerAgency.maxRollCapDesc: Maximum Stage 1 temptation probability per check ({cap}%).
partnerAgency.maxSecretLoversDesc: Maximum concurrent ongoing secret affair lovers a single player partner can have ({count}).
partnerAgency.allowWhenHappyDesc: When disabled, partners in the Happy affection tier are completely immune unless Revenge (player caught cheating) is triggered.
partnerAgency.enableNeglectDesc: Increase temptation when the player goes several days without meaningful affection interaction (starts after {troubledDays} [{troubledMult}x L] for Troubled/Estranged partners, or after {contentDays} [{contentMult}x L] for Content partners).
partnerAgency.enableRevengeDesc: Significantly increase temptation (+20%, amplified by Jealous/Proud temperaments) when the partner has an ongoing exposed affair against them by the player.
partnerAgency.enableHierarchyDesc: Apply a minor temptation increase for lower-ranked spouses in polygamous households (Rank 1: 0%, Rank 2: +3%, Rank 3: +5%, Rank 4+: +7%).
partnerAgency.enableChildrenAnchorDesc: Reduce temptation (-12% if sharing children with the player, and hard-immune while pregnant) to reflect family commitment.
partnerAgency.multipliersTitle: Day-Threshold Multipliers (Relative to Loneliness Threshold L)
partnerAgency.multipliersSubtitle: All Partner Agency and Affection time windows scale from Base Loneliness Threshold (L = {days})
partnerAgency.baseLonelinessDesc_one: Master time unit (L = {count} day) from which all Partner Agency and Affection day thresholds below are calculated.
partnerAgency.baseLonelinessDesc_other: Master time unit (L = {count} days) from which all Partner Agency and Affection day thresholds below are calculated.
partnerAgency.scanIntervalDesc: How often scheduled Partner Agency evaluations run ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.lonelinessDecayDesc: Days without player interaction before daily affection loneliness decay and open-partner loneliness desire begin ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.recentAttentionDesc: Window after spending time with the player where partners receive breakup boosts with side lovers, guilt confession eligibility, and neglect mitigation ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.veryRecentVisitDesc: Window after a player visit where open-relationship partners have reduced desire to seek a new side lover ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.neglectTroubledDesc: Days without player interaction before neglect temptation starts growing for Troubled/Estranged (<50 affection) partners ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.neglectContentDesc: Days without player interaction before Content (50–74 affection) partners lose immunity and begin accumulating neglect temptation ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.prolongedAbsenceDesc: Days of player absence after which a cheating partner becomes less likely (-10%) to break off an ongoing secret affair ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.talkingEscalationDesc: Duration of an unresolved Talking affair before it deterministically escalates to a Physical affair ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.minSideFlingAgeDesc: Minimum duration a secret affair or open-relationship side fling must last before breakup rolls are evaluated ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.intentTtlDesc: How long a queued partner conversation intent (SuggestOpen, SuggestClose, ConfessTalking, ConfessPhysical) waits for the player before expiring ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.homeCooldownDesc: Minimum cooldown per home location between triggered side-lover arrival scenarios ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.affairFatigueLabel: Affair Fatigue & Open Fling Novelty Fade Onset
partnerAgency.affairFatigueDesc: Duration of a secret affair or open fling before novelty fades and breakup likelihood increases with age ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.romanticAttendedDesc: Window after player interaction where a Romantic partner gets a 1.25x boost to breaking off a secret affair out of devotion ({mult}x L = {days}).
partnerAgency.suggestOpenNeglectDesc: Days without player interaction before neglect begins adding bonus probability to proposing an open relationship ({mult}x L = {days}).

scenes.bannerDesc: When entering locations, M.A.R.A.S dynamically selects eligible NPC couples to play immersive voiced (if you are using SkyrimNet) interaction scenes that reflect their current relationship status or illicit affairs.
scenes.enableMasterDesc: Master toggle for all relationship and encounter scenes. If disabled, no couples will be coordinated or prompted into scenes.
scenes.cooldownDesc: Minimum game hours that must pass before another NPC scene can trigger (default 24 hours = at most one scene per day).
scenes.datingDesc: Enable conversational scenes between NPCs who are actively dating.
scenes.loverDesc: Enable intimate and affectionate banter scenes between established lovers.
scenes.engagedDesc: Enable scenes between betrothed couples planning their union.
scenes.marriedDesc: Enable domestic and affectionate scenes between married spouses.
scenes.openRelDesc: Enable scenes between partners in open relationships discussing their dynamic or other partners.
scenes.cheatingSecretDesc: Enable clandestine dialogue between unfaithful partners meeting in secret.
scenes.cheatingDiscoveredDesc: Enable dramatic confrontation scenes when an affair is discovered by a primary partner.
scenes.cheatingCaughtLabel: Cheating: Caught in the Act Scenes
scenes.cheatingCaughtDesc: Enable walk-in encounters where cheaters are caught mid-act (requires sex framework and interior bed).
scenes.locTempleDesc: Allow scenes inside temples and sacred places of worship.
scenes.locStoreDesc: Allow scenes inside merchant shops, apothecaries, and trade stalls.
scenes.locStewardDesc: Allow scenes inside jarl keeps, steward chambers, and court palaces.
scenes.locInnDesc: Allow scenes inside taverns, inns, and public drinking houses.
scenes.locHouseDesc: Allow scenes inside residential homes and civilian quarters.
scenes.locBarracksDesc: Allow scenes inside city guard barracks and military quarters.
scenes.locGuildDesc: Allow scenes inside guild halls, sanctuaries, and faction headquarters.
scenes.locPlayerHouseDesc: Allow scenes inside purchased player-owned homes (e.g., Breezehome, Proudspire).
scenes.locHomesteadDesc: Allow scenes inside player-built Hearthfire manors (e.g., Lakeview, Heljarchen, Windstad).
scenes.locTownDesc: Allow outdoor street scenes in towns (e.g., Riverwood, Falkreath, Dawnstar).
scenes.locSettlementDesc: Allow outdoor street scenes in small settlements, mining camps, and mills.
scenes.locStrongholdDesc: Allow outdoor scenes inside Orc strongholds (e.g., Dushnikh Yal, Narzulbur).
scenes.locCityDesc: Allow outdoor street scenes in major walled cities (e.g., Whiterun, Solitude, Windhelm).
scenes.locLumberMillDesc: Allow outdoor scenes around operating lumber mills.
scenes.locFarmDesc: Allow outdoor scenes around rural farms and agrarian homesteads.

children.trainingDurationDesc_one: Number of in-game days required for a child in Stage 3 (Training) to graduate to Stage 4 (Adult) ({count} day). You can also complete training early from the child's profile.
children.trainingDurationDesc_other: Number of in-game days required for a child in Stage 3 (Training) to graduate to Stage 4 (Adult) ({count} days). You can also complete training early from the child's profile.
children.trainingCostDesc: Gold required to send a player child away for adolescent training ({cost} gold). Set to 0 for free training.
children.requireFactionLabel: Require Faction Membership for Guild Training
children.requireFactionDesc: When enabled, sending a player child to guild, temple, or Daedric covenant training requires the Player to meet that location's membership or patronage criteria.
children.globalBanCritterDesc: Globally disable kid critter adoption events (foxes, hares, mudcrabs) for all children.
children.globalBanPetDesc: Globally disable household pet adoption events (dogs) for all children.
children.prioritizeBioParentDesc: When divorcing, if only one partner is the biological parent, award custody to them (overrides gender and player rules).
children.genderCustodyDesc: Determines which parent retains child custody upon divorce when biological rules do not decide.
children.playerCustodyDesc: Overrides gender custody in divorces involving the Player.

fertility.subtleBaseTooltip: Initial discovery probability on day 0 of birth (0–100%)
fertility.subtleDailyTooltip: Daily probability increase added per day since birth (e.g. 2.0% / day)
fertility.subtleMaxTooltip: Maximum upper probability cap for subtle discovery (0–100%)
fertility.subtleFormulaHelp: Standard subtle tick: gradual physical trait resemblance increases each day the child grows.
fertility.phenotypeBirthDesc: Probability to immediately trigger a paternity secret evaluation upon birth when child has distinct racial/visual discrepancies with presumed father.
fertility.phenotypeInactiveBadgeTooltip: Because birth evaluation chance is 100%, phenotype secrets are evaluated immediately upon birth and will not trigger daily growth.
fertility.phenotypeDisabledTooltip: Disabled: secret evaluates immediately at birth (100%)
fertility.phenotypeBaseTooltip: Base starting probability when distinct visual/racial discrepancy exists (0–100%)
fertility.phenotypeDailyTooltip: Daily probability increase when visual differences become more glaring each day (e.g. 4.0% / day)
fertility.phenotypeMaxTooltip: Maximum upper probability cap for phenotype mismatch (0–100%)
fertility.phenotypeInactiveHelp: Daily formula is inactive because Birth Evaluation Chance is set to 100% (paternity secrets are evaluated immediately at birth). Lower the birth evaluation chance above to allow daily growth.
fertility.phenotypeActiveHelp: Accelerated daily tick: glaring visual differences between biological and presumed father become noticeable much faster.
fertility.optOutLlmLabel: Opt Out of LLM (Use Dice Rolls)
fertility.optOutLlmDesc: When enabled, bypasses SkyrimNet LLM evaluation for paternity secrets and uses the deterministic dice-roll method below.
fertility.revealChanceFallbackDesc: Probability that paternity secret is revealed when fallback triggers (e.g. if SkyrimNet evaluation fails). Phenotype mismatches always reveal immediately (100%).
fertility.revealChanceDirectDesc: Probability that paternity secret is revealed when evaluation triggers without LLM. Phenotype mismatches always reveal immediately (100%).
fertility.breakupChanceDesc: When paternity secret is revealed, probability that the presumed father breaks up or divorces the mother upon discovering he is not the biological father.
fertility.bioStepInChanceDesc: If breakup/divorce occurs and the biological father is available to marry, probability that he steps in, marries the mother, and becomes the child's recognized parent.

aiDialogue.title: AI Dialogue & Interactions
aiDialogue.targetGenderDesc: Filter which NPCs can initiate dynamic romance dialogues.
aiDialogue.minRelRankDesc: Required RelationshipRank integer (-4 to 4) for dialogue initiation ({rank}).

skyrimNet.disabledSimDesc: Non-SkyrimNet simulation is currently active. M.A.R.A.S features operate under standard non-AI rules (Dice Roll matchmaking, vanilla proposal dialog, 2-button modals). You can disable simulation in Cheats & Debug Settings.
skyrimNet.notDetectedDesc: SkyrimNet is required for AI-generated dialogue, prompt actions, and response confirmation modals. Features in this section are automatically disabled per mod safety gating rules.
skyrimNet.activeBanner: SkyrimNet DLL Active — Prompt extensions & event listeners registered.
skyrimNet.actionRadiusDesc: Maximum distance in game units (~70 units ≈ 1 meter) to scan for valid partner targets. If no eligible target actor is within this radius, proposal and consideration actions remain unavailable.
skyrimNet.useDecisionsDesc: When enabled, matchmaking verification, player-partner agency, paternity secret reveals, and bio-father step-in evaluations use SkyrimNet's typed Jev Decisions API (single-pass probability scoring with no broken JSON errors). Automatically falls back to the legacy Chat LLM prompt if no Decisions route is configured in SkyrimNet.
skyrimNet.llmMemoriesDesc: When enabled, relationship, infidelity, pregnancy, paternity, birth, and custody events are sent to SkyrimNet's memory LLM to generate narrative first-person memories. When disabled, memories are built programmatically without sending an LLM request.

cheats.alwaysSuccessDesc: Bypass marriage difficulty calculations and guarantee 100% proposal acceptance.
cheats.debugSpellDesc: Grant player the M.A.R.A.S Debug Spell to inspect NPC stats in-game.
cheats.simulateNoSkyrimNetDesc: Force M.A.R.A.S to simulate SkyrimNet being absent. Disables AI dialogue events, prompts, and LLM matchmaking, enabling traditional non-AI fallbacks without disabling SkyrimNet.esp/dll.
cheats.logLevelDesc: Configure spdlog output threshold for C++ plugin logs.
cheats.logDestDesc: Select where plugin log messages are written.
cheats.dumpDataLabel: Dump All Stored Data to JSON
cheats.dumpDataDesc: Export all MARAS relationship pairs, NPC profiles, affection values, child registry, household tenancy, spouse hierarchy, and settings into a timestamped JSON file (Data/SKSE/Plugins/MARAS/dumps/).
cheats.dumpDataUnknownError: An unknown error occurred while saving dump file.
cheats.dumpNpcIndexDesc: Export all indexed NPCs (Base & Ref FormIDs, Names, EditorIDs, Races, Sex, Child status, loaded state, and INI rules) currently cached in the M.A.R.A.S NPC Index to a timestamped file (Data/SKSE/Plugins/MARAS/dumps/).
cheats.dumpNpcIndexUnknownError: An unknown error occurred while saving NPC index dump.
